invalidation_rules: Source drift (component source fingerprint change) -> INVALIDATE per R-SRC-001
Test drift (component test fingerprint change) -> INVALIDATE per R-SRC-003
Config drift (mutation-dependent evidence) -> INVALIDATE per R-CFG-001
Toolchain drift (mutation evidence) -> INVALIDATE per R-CFG-002
Task definition drift -> INVALIDATE per R-TASK-001
Capability mapping drift -> INVALIDATE (C42.24 discovery drift)
CI evidence change -> INVALIDATE per CIDriftReport
